metadata.title: LOR. — Live Open Rooms
metadata.description: Open-source video meetings that remember. No account, no time limit, no download.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: This page needs the network. Once you are back online, open your meeting link again.

home.tagline: Open-source video meetings that remember. No account, no time limit, no download.
home.codeSwitchExample: And it understands you when you say «عملت الـ <term>deploy</term> على الـ <term>server</term>».

launcher.joinLabel: Or join one you were sent

errors.badCode: That code is not right. Check it, or paste the whole link.
errors.createFailed: The meeting could not be created. Try again.
errors.tooMany: That is a lot of meetings in a short time. Wait a little and try again.
errors.offline: No connection. Check your network and try again.

room.shareToInvite: Send this link to anyone you want in the room.
room.checkBeforeJoining: See and hear yourself before anyone else does.

errors.locked: This room is locked. The host has stopped letting people in.
errors.notFound: That room does not exist. Check the link.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a little and try again.
errors.joinFailed: You could not be let in. Try again.
errors.offline: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.removed: You were removed from this meeting and cannot rejoin it.

room.qrLabel: QR code for this meeting's link
room.qrHint: Or point a phone camera at this.

waiting.title: Waiting to be let in
waiting.body: The host has been asked to let <n>{name}</n> in. This screen moves on by itself.

hostGone.title: Nobody is in the room yet
hostGone.body: There is no host here to let <n>{name}</n> in. You can wait, or come back when the meeting starts.

denied.title: You were not let in
denied.body: The host did not let <n>{name}</n> into this meeting.

denied.title: Permission denied
denied.fix: {browser} is blocking camera and microphone access. Open the site permissions for this page, allow both, then press Try again.

notFound.title: No device found
notFound.fix: No camera or microphone is connected. Plug one in and try again — you can also join with audio only, or just listen.

inUse.title: Device is busy
inUse.fix: Another application is holding the camera or microphone — usually another video call. Close it, then try again.

insecureContext.title: Connection is not secure
insecureContext.fix: Browsers only grant camera and microphone access over HTTPS. Open this page on https:// or on localhost.

unsupported.title: Browser not supported
unsupported.fix: This browser cannot do video calls. Try a current version of Chrome, Firefox, or Safari.

unknown.title: Could not open your devices
unknown.fix: Something unexpected went wrong opening the camera or microphone. Try again, and reload the page if it keeps happening.

call.aloneInRoom: You are the only one here. Send the link to someone.

quality.reduced: Your connection got weak, so video was turned down to keep the audio going.

call.waitingToPublish: Waiting for the host to let you in before you can turn anything on.

chat.title: Chat
chat.noHistory: Chat lasts as long as the call does. Anything sent before you joined is not here, and nothing said here is kept afterwards.
chat.sendFailed: That message did not send. Check your connection and try again.

whiteboard.title: Board
whiteboard.live: Changes appear for everyone in this call.
whiteboard.legacyNotice: The previous board is preserved as an archive. New drawings use this board.

notes.title: Notes
notes.live: Changes appear for everyone in this call.
notes.editorHint: Type, paste, and format notes. Changes are shared with everyone in this call.
notes.heading: Heading

recording.title: Record
recording.ready: Your WebM is ready in this tab. It will not be sent anywhere.
recording.noAudio: No call audio was available when recording began, so this clip has video only.
recording.needVideo: Turn on your camera or start screen sharing before recording.
recording.fallback: This browser cannot make a local WebM recording. Use current Chrome, Edge, or Firefox.

error.unsupported: This browser cannot make a local WebM recording.
error.no-video: Turn on your camera or start screen sharing before recording.
error.failed: The browser could not save the local recording. Try again.
error.empty: No usable recording was made. Try again and keep the selected video on.
error.source-ended: The selected video ended before a usable recording was made.
error.source-changed: The selected video changed. Start a new recording for the new source.

warning.source-ended: The selected video ended. This is the usable part recorded before it stopped.
warning.source-changed: The selected video changed. This is the usable part from the previous source.

hands.waiting: {count, plural, one {# hand up} other {# hands up}}

door.title: Waiting room
door.denyIsFinal: Turning somebody away is final for this meeting. They cannot ask again.
door.toggleHint: With this off, anyone with the link joins straight away.
door.off: The door is open — anyone with the link joins straight away.
door.lockHint: Nobody new gets in at all, not even to wait.
door.lockedNote: The room is locked. Nobody new can get as far as waiting.

announce.muteAll: The host muted everyone. You can unmute yourself.
announce.remove: The host removed <n>{name}</n> from the meeting.
announce.lock: The host locked the room. Nobody new can join.

captions.noticeOn: Captions are on. What you say is transcribed and sent to a transcription service.
captions.noticeNotYou: Captions are on. Your microphone is not being transcribed.

error.no_key: No transcription key is set up on this server.
error.rate_limited: Too much at once — captions will catch up shortly.
error.failed: Captions could not reach the transcription service.
error.quota: Today's free transcription is used up. Captions stop here; the meeting does not. Add your own key to carry on.

captions.runningLow: About {minutes} min of free transcription left today.

keys.title: Your own key
keys.blurb: Stored in this browser and encrypted there — not on our server, and not in your account. It is here until you remove it or clear this site's data.
keys.saveFailed: This browser would not store it. Private windows often refuse.
keys.goesDirect: Your audio goes straight from this browser to the provider. It never reaches our server, and neither does the key.
keys.goesViaServer: This provider refuses browser requests, so the audio passes through our server. It forwards and returns; nothing is kept.

transcript.title: What was said
transcript.empty: Nothing kept yet. Turn on “Keep a record” while captions are running and settled lines are stored here.
transcript.generated: written by a model — check it against the transcript
transcript.stale: More has been said since this was written.
transcript.retention: Available for {days} days. Expired text and its summary are removed when the record is opened. Anybody in this meeting can delete it now.

error.no_key: No summary key is set up on this server. The transcript is still kept.
error.quota: That is enough summaries of this meeting for today.
error.too_short: Not enough was said to summarise.
error.nothing_to_summarise: There is nothing stored to summarise.
error.unavailable: The summary service could not be reached. The transcript is untouched.

canvas.retention: Shared board and notes are kept for {days} days. Anyone in this meeting can delete the saved Canvas.
canvas.deleted: The saved Canvas was deleted. People still in this call can continue working, and a later edit may create a new saved Canvas.
canvas.expired: The saved Canvas expired after {days} days, so this call starts with an empty board and notes. New work can be saved.
canvas.malformed: The saved Canvas could not be restored, so it was not loaded. You can continue with an empty board and notes.
canvas.unavailable: The saved Canvas could not be reached. The call continues, and changes will be saved when the connection returns.
canvas.saveFailed: The shared Canvas could not be saved. The call continues and LOR. will try again.
canvas.tooLarge: This shared Canvas is too large to save. The live call continues, but new changes will not be kept after everyone leaves.

keeping.notice: What is said is being kept after this meeting.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.intro: Review proposals against the exact words they came from.
decisions.extractHint: A model suggests candidates from the kept record. Nothing becomes a decision until you confirm it.
decisions.extracted: The review queue is up to date.
decisions.emptyHost: No decisions yet. Once there is enough kept conversation, you can ask for proposals to review.
decisions.emptyGuest: No confirmed decisions yet. Proposed decisions are visible only to the meeting host.
decisions.modelGenerated: Written by a model — review before confirming.
decisions.deleteConfirm: Delete this decision? Its source line will remain in the meeting record.
decisions.exportUnavailable: Confirm a decision before there is anything to download.
decisions.retention: Evidence is available for {days} days. If its source expires, the linked decision is removed too.

error.no_key: No decision-review key is set up on this server. The record is still kept.
error.quota: That is enough decision reviews for this meeting today.
error.transcript_too_short: Not enough has been kept to review for decisions yet.
error.nothing_to_extract: There is no kept record to review yet.
error.unavailable: Decisions could not be reached. The meeting and record continue; try again.
error.host_lost: You are no longer the meeting host, so the review controls were removed.
error.decision_unavailable: This decision is no longer available. The record was refreshed.
error.decision_text_invalid: Write a decision before saving it.

carryOver.summary: {count, plural, =1 {1 open task from a previous meeting} other {# open tasks from a previous meeting}}
carryOver.failed: Couldn’t check open tasks from a previous meeting. Your call is still running.

actionItems.title: Action items
actionItems.intro: Review each task beside the exact words it came from.
actionItems.extractHint: A model suggests only assigned commitments from the kept record. A task stays a proposal until you set its owner and due date.
actionItems.extracted: The review queue is up to date.
actionItems.emptyHost: No action items yet. Once enough conversation is kept, you can ask for proposals to review.
actionItems.emptyGuest: No open or completed action items yet. Proposals are visible only to the meeting host.
actionItems.modelGenerated: Written by a model — review before opening.
actionItems.dueHint: Use the meeting's agreed calendar day.
actionItems.deleteConfirm: Delete this action item? Its source line will remain in the meeting record.
actionItems.sessionBoundary: Tasks belong to this browser session, not an account. A new browser session is not silently the same person.
actionItems.retention: Evidence is available for {days} days. If its source expires, the linked action item is removed too.

error.no_key: No action-item review key is set up on this server. The record is still kept.
error.quota: That is enough action-item reviews for this meeting today.
error.transcript_too_short: Not enough has been kept to review for action items yet.
error.nothing_to_extract: There is no kept record to review yet.
error.timeout: Action-item review took too long. The record is untouched; try again.
error.unavailable: Action items could not be reached. The meeting and record continue; try again.
error.host_lost: You are no longer the meeting host, so the review controls were removed.
error.action_item_unavailable: This action item is no longer available. The record was refreshed.
error.action_item_text_invalid: Write a task before opening it.
error.action_item_owner_invalid: Choose a participant from this meeting before opening the task.
error.action_item_due_invalid: Choose a complete YYYY-MM-DD due date before opening the task.

keys.title: Getting a key
keys.intro: Captions send audio to a transcription service, and that costs somebody money. This server may offer a free allowance; when it runs out, or when there is none, you can use your own key instead. Here is where one comes from.
keys.freeYes: Yes — about {hours} hours of audio a day.
keys.freeNo: No free tier for the API. Pay as you go.
keys.limitsDetail: About {hoursPerHour} hours of audio an hour, and {requests} requests a minute.
keys.card_no: No — not to sign up and use the free tier.
keys.card_yes: Yes, before the API can be used.
keys.card_unstated: Their pricing page does not say.
keys.pathDirect: Straight from your browser to them. It never reaches this server, and neither does your key.
keys.pathProxy: Through this server, which forwards it and keeps nothing. Their API refuses requests made from a browser.
keys.howToAdd: To use one: turn captions on in a meeting, then open “Your own key” from the notice at the bottom of the screen. It is stored in your browser, encrypted, and you can remove it there at any time.
keys.noAffiliates: None of these are affiliate or referral links. Free tiers change — the date on each card is when its numbers were last read from the provider's own documentation.
keys.pathUntested: Through this server, which forwards it and keeps nothing. Nobody has tested whether they accept requests made directly from a browser, so LOR. takes the route that certainly works.
